tiers.name: qualification
tiers.scope: Deterministic money, admission, identity, evidence, pricing, and workload invariants

tiers.name: normal
tiers.scope: Short Go, Rust, and SDK package suites
tiers.skip_policy: Database cases may explicitly skip without a local database; no pass is synthesized.

tiers.name: integration
tiers.scope: Isolated PostgreSQL, object storage, provider agent, and cross-process public API loop
tiers.skip_policy: Unavailable services remain unavailable and cause the dependent gate to fail or report its explicit skip.

tiers.name: certification
tiers.scope: Full CI, security, portability, evidence, mutation, release-image, and governance gates
tiers.skip_policy: Only repository allowlisted opt-in skips are acceptable; missing required dependencies are not a pass.
